source: 3.2 ENGINES.yaml (THREAD 3.2-EXP V16, Path B MVP-4, born 2026-09-14)

bespoke.status_note: author verdict: «хороший батч, в меру эротический, идея была» — concept-on-girl confirmed at render (S010)
bespoke.law: the concept is TAILORED ON the girl — worn as a garment cut to her exact measurements; the wardrobe IS the thesis
bespoke.on_body: every concept-manifestation is a wardrobe STATE on her (fabric, fit, failure, fastening) — never a prop, never a backdrop
bespoke.strong_pairs: bust/hands LEAD + wardrobe-failure K (K139-154 sin-native family); LQ08 colored-gel / LQ01 hard-key; palettes with exactly one moral accent; FET scenario hooks as the sin's occasion
failure_modes: costume party — the sin as decoration AROUND her, not fitted ON her (the N22 autopsy: «весь батч — волт»)
sermon — morality narrated in prose while the render shows a normal girl in a nice dress; if the law isn't visible in fabric, it isn't there

tint.status_note: V15 process closed live on this batch; renders pending at library birth — promotion to proven on render verdict
tint.law: the concept is DYED INTO her — color as substance, absorbed into fabric/skin/hair chemistry, saturation as emotional state
tint.on_body: the tint lives IN the material (dye-work, absorption, staining) — the color answers her body, not the lighting
tint.strong_pairs: collarbone/lips LEAD + stillness K; monochrome-deep palettes (the TINT family P83-88 mint); LQ10/LQ14 cool ambient; the one non-family accent at full saturation (§51)
failure_modes: filter look — color ON her instead of IN her; a girl standing in blue light is a tourist, not a dyer
monochrome monotony — the wash risk the §51 anti-wash guards exist for; without the single saturated anchor the batch goes grey

counterfall.status_note: text-level praise at the 2026-09-14 review (S011); render pending
counterfall.law: one physical law of the world inverted — DRY FALLS / WET RISES; the reversal MEASURED ON her, undressing by claim-by-water, the wind retired
counterfall.on_body: the wet is a climbing animal with manners: hems claimed upward, weave gone transparent in its own time, cuffs peeling off the ankles; ONE DOWNWARD WITNESS per frame (the bead/chain/key/weight — the direction that stays is the direction that loves)
counterfall.strong_pairs: LQ04 underlight (light from below — the risen water's own glow) + low/waterline frames; K61 drip / K82 invert-suspend / K175-181 uprise family; witness = one warm metal (gold/brass/amber); eclipse-violet / ink-blue / ember-rust depth families
failure_modes: scenery-girl — the physics admired in the environment while she stands dryly in it (the N22 lesson, generalized)
wet-filter — wetness as adjective, not as claim; if the water never TAKES anything (fabric, warmth, direction), it's weather reportage
witness-rhetoric — the downward witness and the LEAD repeating one job; three witnesses in a file must not share a register (custody / comedy / labor — the N25 OC trio's answer)

cantus.status_note: debuted 2026-09-14; promotion to proven awaits the render verdict per the ENGINES birth protocol
cantus.law: the garment is a sustained note — cloth woven from the wearing voice; the weave obeys the mouth that keeps it, and silence is what undoes: the hems hold while the note holds, the unravel travels at breath-speed, the threads stream TOWARD the source
cantus.on_body: every manifestation is a wardrobe STATE answering the voice — hem-lag at the phrase's end, seams resigning at the breath's failure, the sung-on garment belonging to the song's grammar and the UNSUNG things (brass, steel, bone, leather) staying on because the song has no jurisdiction over what it never touched
cantus.strong_pairs: throat/lips/hands LEAD + the K118-K132 breath-and-lag return family + the K185-K188 breath-ledger mints; LQ07 beam / LQ05 follow-spot (the light as accompanist); the brass witness per frame (coins, kettle, metronome, bell, cowbell, dog-tag, tape, dials, faucet, key-ring); one girl per relationship-to-song (discovery / economy / estate)
failure_modes: concert-attendance — the girl standing IN a music scene while her own wardrobe ignores it (the N22 scenery lesson in acoustic form: if the law isn't visible in cloth, it isn't there)
note-symbol kitsch — floating musical notation as decoration; the music must live in the FABRIC'S BEHAVIOR (streaming threads, breath-speed unravel), never in printed staves

one-metaphor monotony — 21 girls all unraveling identically; the trio of registers (discovery / economy / estate) and the three OC answers (split-duet / unspendable-clause / laughter-re-weave) are the vaccine

limen.status_note: debut 2026-09-14; promotion awaits the render verdict per the ENGINES birth protocol
limen.law: magic is ADJACENT, not abroad — it arrives through SEAMS (door's edge, mirror's plane, laundry line, tide's rim, curb, hem of fog); every frame carries ONE VISIBLE SEAM cutting the composition, the girl straddling it MID-CROSSING — and the magic is legible AT A GLANCE, never narrated (the N26 audit's lesson: «ничё толком не понял»)
limen.on_body: the seam claims her WARDROBE, not the scenery: which side of the boundary a garment is ON decides its physics (a hem dry on the mundane side, beaded with tide on the magic side; a sleeve lit by two weathers at the shoulder); ONE MUNDANE WITNESS per frame — the one ordinary object that refuses the magic (the kettle still steaming, the bus sign, the parking meter) — the lineage's witness tradition continued: downward -> unsung -> MUNDANE
limen.strong_pairs: POSE-FIRST design per the v3.0 usage doctrine (the threshold family PL229-240 + one striking pose per frame — RF-001's law: the pose decides); K192-K195 seam kinetics + the K139-154 garment-kinetic returns; LQ07 beam / LQ15 bioluminescent / LQ11 prism for the far side, LQ06/LQ10 for the near; the seam palettes P89-P99 (domestic base + one magic accent, the palette ITSELF straddling); the camera crossing WITH her (CAM10 through-element, CAM11 mirror, CAM16 hip-gate) when the seam is a plane
failure_modes: wardrobe-portal — magic framed as a glowing doorway SHE STANDS NEAR while her clothes stay mundane (the scenery-girl failure in threshold form; the seam must claim fabric, not just floorspace)

theme-opaque — beautiful seam prose that renders as 'girl in nice light' (the N26 verdict «ничё толком не понял, потому что набор полуголых девчонок»; the seam line must be the FIRST READ of the silhouette, visible without the prose)

uniform wonder — 21 identical fairy doors; the seam's LOCATION and MATERIAL rotate every prompt (21 distinct seams, zero repeats), the NICHE slots carry the impossible-physics read while VOLT slots carry the wardrobe read — the genre split working as designed

arcana.status_note: RF-003 (2026-09-16): the RATING half proven («проблемную задачу с рейтингом ты решил» — PH-proof doctrine confirmed, R7/R+12/X2 held at render), the STYLE half failed («сборище милфух-мамочек в одежде, через которую просвечивается нижнее бельё» — the DEGREE axis collapsed into one carrier; see §61 / V19 for the fix). Kept as the lineage's rating-proof engine; never again as a one-carrier style.
arcana.law: the secret is WORN — one kept secret per frame, one visible tell, one confidant (the object that knows); undressing is disclosure
arcana.on_body: every frame carries ONE KEPT SECRET WITH A VISIBLE TELL riding the wardrobe: the boot's inner seam, the candy lining, the filed horns under the bob — the reveal graded, one step more than the world gets
arcana.strong_pairs: hands/throat LEAD + the secret-carrying zone; LQ06 bounced / LQ05 spot; the P100-P105 secret families (modest dominant + one giveaway accent); FET11 mirror_voyeur as the confidant's own frame
failure_modes: one-carrier collapse — the secret delivered by sheer alone reads as one age register (the milf stamp); §61(2) anti-monopoly is the vaccine
strap-layer bug — an under-strap escaping through a closed outer garment («лифчик под одеждой, лямки — снаружи»); §4F named exits are the fix

apocrypha.status_note: debuted 2026-09-16; promotion awaits the render verdict per the ENGINES birth protocol
apocrypha.law: the scene is FOUND, not authored — the world runs on improvisation; nothing in-frame knows it is being seen, so nothing composes for the viewer; the wardrobe is always MID-LIFE (mid-motion, mid-accident, mid-recovery) and the frame's honesty is that nobody posed it
apocrypha.on_body: every carrier is a CAUGHT state — the garment mid-slip, the fabric mid-recover, the imprint fresh, the weight still settling; the U/E/I/D classes are the native register (situational, displaced, aftermath, physics), transparency demoted to a capped guest; ONE ACCIDENTAL WITNESS per frame — the object that caught the scene without meaning to (mirror, shop glass, security monitor, door gap, propped phone, traffic mirror, the mimic's own copied seams) — the witness tradition's fifth register: downward -> unsung -> mundane -> confidant -> ACCIDENTAL
apocrypha.strong_pairs: seat/hips/thighs LEAD (the zones she cannot self-monitor — candid territory) + caught-state K (the glance back, the failed tuck, the rim haul); LQ12 UV laundromat / LQ01 hard diner key / LQ06 bounced shelter / LQ13 firelight oven / LQ15 biolum nest; the GAR57-59 physics-undresses family (the undressing performed by physics, unhurried — nobody's authorship); CAM16 hip-gate / CAM11 mirror / the fisheye monitor framings
failure_modes: posed-candid — a girl obviously working the lens is a written scene; the N22 scenery lesson in candid form (if the wardrobe serves the viewer, the scene was authored)
witness-parade — 21 mirrors in a row is a gallery, not a world; the witness object rotates per frame the way LIMEN's seams did
candid-flat — 'nobody wrote it' used as an excuse for zero craft; the improvised scene still carries core-4 (§61) — found, not starved

lineage_note:
BESPOKE -> TINT -> COUNTERFALL -> CANTUS -> LIMEN -> ARCANA -> APOCRYPHA: sin as
  garment -> color as substance -> physics as measurement -> voice as employer ->
  boundary as garment -> the secret as garment -> THE SCENE UNWRITTEN. Seven
  generations of one idea (the concept must live IN/ON the material world of
  her body), each tightening the N22 law. New engines join by proving an entry
  at debut; historical batches (Requiem -> GOD LEFT THE LIGHTS ON) are
  retro-documented on demand — no invention without the receipts.

entry_format.on_body: the exact channels the law claims on the girl
entry_format.strong_pairs: LEAD + K + LQ + palette families that carried it
entry_format.failure_modes: the observed ways it dies (from post-mortems)

definition: AN ENGINE IS NOT A THEME. An engine is a PHYSICAL/METAPHORICAL LAW of the world that can be worn; every engine answers the N22 question first: HOW DOES THIS LAW SIT ON HER? (hem / hair / weave / kinetic / wardrobe-state — never scenery).
